question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 10.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**diary**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of given words.
 
• **message: **a verbal, written, or recorded communication sent to or left for a recipient who cannot be contacted directly.
 
• **diary: **a book in which one keeps a daily record of events and experiences.
 
• **notebook: **a small book with blank or ruled pages for writing notes in.
 
• **copy: **a thing made to be similar or identical to another.
 
• The word **diary **is the most appropriate in the given sentence as per the meaning of the words.
 
 
• **Example**:* Richard liked to write in his **diary **__every night.*
 
 

**Hence, the correct answer is option 2**

Known locally as Chateaux Picomtal, Picomtal Castle (3) recently came under new ownership. During renovation of the(4)property, a surprising discovery was made. Messages (5) written long ago were found on the floorboards of (6) the upper chambers. The messages were written (7)between1880 and 1881 by Joachim Martin; the carpenter__ __(8)who installed the flooring. His messages were a diary of 72 entries of his daily __(__9) life, personal thoughts along with his emotions and feelings. Joachim’s (10)diary is indeed a very personal account of the history of those times. The discovery gives us an honest look at an average person’s daily life over 135 years ago.*
